falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low equivalent would invalidate the bottom pattern match; the 76% similarity to bottom_2024_aug requires holding above that structural support level

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling rather than bottoming behavior, invalidating the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.50% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality bid this extreme would signal recession/depression pricing, not the soft-landing bottom formation implied by the August 2024 pattern; the macro regime would have shifted to crisis mode

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
